About.title: Beyond the code
About.lead: I believe great software starts with <highlight>understanding problems</highlight>, not just writing code.
About.background: I'm a backend engineer from Brazil, working on software architecture, distributed systems, and financial technology.
About.approach: I enjoy tackling complex challenges, making thoughtful technical decisions, and collaborating with teams to build solutions that are reliable, maintainable, and meaningful.

stepp.imageAlt: Stepp screen showing reading, running, gym and travel habits with their completion history

decore.imageAlt: Decorê Arts homepage showcasing personalized wooden art
